sources.observation: Two octagonal windowed drums rise from stepped square roof bases. A small domed canopy leads through the open stone porch. The courtyard galleries have two rows of rounded arches.

sources.credit: Wikimedia Commons, see linked file for attribution
sources.observation: The west chapel and two-storey galleries enclose an open courtyard. Pale rounded arch bands, narrow stone columns and grey roofs tie the church and ranges together.

limitations: The church footprint and drum centers follow the mapped parts. Church drum heights, window details and secondary roof profiles are photo-based estimates. The model covers the main enclosure and its south approach gates.
